description: Compact working context into KEEP / ARCHIVE / DISCARD with estimated token counts. Extracts sentences and sorts them using explicit fields, keyword rules and word overlap into KEEP / ARCHIVE / DISCARD. Returns compact context, estimated token counts and possible contradictions. Review it before adopting it: rules can omit important material. Your existing context is never changed automatically. Registration required. Live price: see list_treatments.
